record.bible_text: <FO><FO><FI> A Psalm<Fi> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> The LORD<WH03068> <FI>is<Fi> my light<WH0216> and my salvation<WH03468>; whom shall I fear<WH03372><WTH8799>? the LORD<WH03068> <FI>is<Fi> the strength<WH04581> of my life<WH02416>; of whom shall I be afraid<WH06342><WTH8799>?

When the wicked<WH07489><WTH8688>, <FI>even<Fi> mine enemies<WH06862> and my foes<WH0341><WTH8802>, came<WH07126><WTH8800> upon me to eat up<WH0398><WTH8800> my flesh<WH01320>, they stumbled<WH03782><WTH8804> and fell<WH05307><WTH8804>. <RF>came...: Heb. approached against me<Rf>

Though an host<WH04264> should encamp<WH02583><WTH8799> against me, my heart<WH03820> shall not fear<WH03372><WTH8799>: though war<WH04421> should rise<WH06965><WTH8799> against me, in this <FI>will<Fi> I <FI>be<Fi> confident<WH0982><WTH8802>.

One<WH0259> <FI>thing<Fi> have I desired<WH07592><WTH8804> of the LORD<WH03068>, that will I seek<WH01245><WTH8762> after; that I may dwell<WH03427><WTH8800> in the house<WH01004> of the LORD<WH03068> all the days<WH03117> of my life<WH02416>, to behold<WH02372><WTH8800> the beauty<WH05278> of the LORD<WH03068>, and to enquire<WH01239><WTH8763> in his temple<WH01964>. <RF>the beauty: or, the delight<Rf>

For in the time<WH03117> of trouble<WH07451> he shall hide<WH06845><WTH8799> me in his pavilion<WH05520>: in the secret<WH05643> of his tabernacle<WH0168> shall he hide<WH05641><WTH8686> me; he shall set me up<WH07311><WTH8787> upon a rock<WH06697>.

And now shall mine head<WH07218> be lifted up<WH07311><WTH8799> above mine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802> round about<WH05439> me: therefore will I offer<WH02076><WTH8799> in his tabernacle<WH0168> sacrifices<WH02077> of joy<WH08643>; I will sing<WH07891><WTH8799>, yea, I will sing praises<WH02167><WTH8762> unto the LORD<WH03068>. <RF>joy: Heb. shouting<Rf><CM>
Hear<WH08085><WTH8798>, O LORD<WH03068>, <FI>when<Fi> I cry<WH07121><WTH8799> with my voice<WH06963>: have mercy<WH02603><WTH8798> also upon me, and answer<WH06030><WTH8798> me.

<FI> When thou saidst<Fi> , Seek<WH01245><WTH8761> ye my face<WH06440>; my heart<WH03820> said<WH0559><WTH8804> unto thee, Thy face<WH06440>, LORD<WH03068>, will I seek<WH01245><WTH8762>. <RF>When...: or, My heart said unto thee, Let my face seek thy face, etc<Rf>

Hide<WH05641><WTH8686> not thy face<WH06440> <FI>far<Fi> from me; put<WH05186><WH00> not thy servant<WH05650> away<WH05186><WTH8686> in anger<WH0639>: thou hast been my help<WH05833>; leave<WH05203><WTH8799> me not, neither forsake<WH05800><WTH8799> me, O God<WH0430> of my salvation<WH03468>.
When my father<WH01> and my mother<WH0517> forsake<WH05800><WTH8804> me, then the LORD<WH03068> will take me up<WH0622><WTH8799>. <RF>take...: Heb. gather me<Rf>

Teach<WH03384><WTH8685> me thy way<WH01870>, O LORD<WH03068>, and lead<WH05148><WTH8798> me in a plain<WH04334> path<WH0734>, because of mine enemies<WH08324><WTH8802>. <RF>a plain...: Heb. a way of plainness<Rf> <RF>mine...: Heb. those which observe me<Rf>

Deliver<WH05414><WTH8799> me not over unto the will<WH05315> of mine enemies<WH06862>: for false<WH08267> witnesses<WH05707> are risen up<WH06965><WTH8804> against me, and such as breathe out<WH03307> cruelty<WH02555>.
<FI> I had fainted<Fi> , unless<WH03884> I had believed<WH0539><WTH8689> to see<WH07200><WTH8800> the goodness<WH02898> of the LORD<WH03068> in the land<WH0776> of the living<WH02416>.

Wait<WH06960><WTH8761> on the LORD<WH03068>: be of good courage<WH02388><WTH8798>, and he shall strengthen<WH0553><WTH8686> thine heart<WH03820>: wait<WH06960><WTH8761>, I say, on the LORD<WH03068>.<CM>
